notes_for_editor: The record's height (32.6 m) and elevation (929.6 m) match the sources: 107 ft and 3,050 ft. The 1936 date comes from one source (Forest Lookouts); firelookout.com gives no date. A 1936 CCC or WPA observation tower is described in the camp history (cite 5), but the sources do not say it is the fire lookout, so no event is recorded for it. Access for the tower itself is not stated anywhere we read; the refuge-wide foot-traffic statement (cite 6) should not be read as permission to climb. firelookout.com credits photos to Scott Schroeder; no photo URL or licence was found, so no photos are added. A person may want to check with the refuge whether the tower is open to the public.
